description: This PHP source file defines the class FIFOEntitlementConsumptionStrategy, implementing the EntitlementConsumptionStrategy interface. It manages leave entitlement consumption following a FIFO strategy within an HRM system. The class contains methods for handling leave creation, cancellation, period changes, and entitlement limits, utilizing dependencies such as DAOs and services related to leave entitlements and periods.

classes.name: FIFOEntitlementConsumptionStrategy
classes.description: Implements FIFO strategy for leave entitlement consumption, handling creation, cancellation, and period change events, and calculating leave without entitlement limits.

methods.name: getDao
methods.description: Returns the DAO object for database interactions; initializes if not already set.

methods.name: handleLeaveCreate
methods.description: Processes leave creation requests, deducting entitlements following FIFO logic over a set of leave dates.

methods.name: handleEntitlementStatusChange
methods.description: Placeholder for handling entitlement status changes; currently not implemented.

methods.name: handleLeaveCancel
methods.description: Reverts leave consumption upon leave cancellation, updating entitlements and date ranges accordingly.

methods.name: handleLeavePeriodChange
methods.description: Adjusts internal state and database records when the leave period dates change.

methods.name: getLeaveWithoutEntitlementDateLimitsForLeaveBalance
methods.description: Calculates date limits for leave without entitlement based on current leave periods.

methods.name: getLeavePeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the current leave period for a specified date.
